summary: Contestants demonstrate their skills in Linux hardware and system configuration, operation and maintenance, security, scripting, troubleshooting, and diagnostics. The event includes an objective test, and at nationals, a certification exam and a hands-on final round for the top 10 contestants. Reference materials are allowed for some portions, and passing the certification exam adds bonus points.
time_limits: Preliminaries – No more than sixty (60) minutes for objective test

Preliminaries (Nationals only) - No more than sixty (60) minutes for objective test, no more than ninety (90) minutes for certification test, and no more than sixty (60) minutes for performance component
Finals - (Nationals only) No more than sixty (60) minutes for performance component
what_to_bring: Published and/or unpublished non-electronic written reference materials
(Optional) Cordless calculator: Electronic devices will be monitored according to ACT standards
competencies: Utilize Linux command line utilities and configure shell environments to manage files, processes, and automate system tasks for optimized workflows
Configure and manage Linux storage devices, file systems, networking, and printing services to support organizational performance and resource availability
Configure, monitor, and manage Linux system access controls, including permissions, ACLs, and authentication mechanisms, to enforce organizational security policies
Install, configure, and update Linux software packages using distribution-specific package management tools to maintain secure and functional systems
Perform Linux operating system installation, configure system bootloaders such as GRUB, and manage boot processes to ensure proper system initialization and recovery capabilities
Create, modify, and manage files using Linux text editors and employ search and manipulation commands to support effective system administration
Configure and administer Linux firewalls, network interfaces, and essential network services to support secure and reliable connectivity
judging_notes: AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed
Business Professionals of America assumes no responsibility for hardware/software provided by the contestant
No equipment, supplies or materials other than those specified for the event will be allowed in the testing area

Previous Business Professionals of America tests and/or sample tests (handwritten, photocopied or keyed) may not be taken into the testing area. Violation of this rule will result in disqualification.

At NLC, contestants will take CompTIA Certmaster Learn Linux+ certification as part of the event. Contestants passing this certification will have 50 points added to their event score. Reference materials are not allowed for certification testing.

The top 10 contestants at nationals will have a final round with a hands-on component. Scores from the preliminary round and objective test do not advance with contestant to finals. Reference materials are allowed for the application portion.
eligibility_notes: Any secondary or postsecondary division contestant may enter this objective event.
